learningGoals: Identify straight and curved lines in the environment. ➖
Differentiate between standing, sleeping, and slanting lines. 📐
Draw simple objects and figures using different types of lines. ✏️
Recognize how lines are used to form alphabet letters and numbers. 🔠
teachingTips: Trace different types of lines in the air using your fingers and have your child copy you. 👆
Ask your child to find standing and sleeping lines in the letters of their own name. 📛
Use a piece of soft string or thread to show how a straight line can easily become a curved line. 🧵
Point out slanting lines on objects like house roofs, ladders, or tree branches during walks. 🌳

funActivities.title: String Art 🎨
funActivities.description: Dip a piece of string in paint and press it onto paper to create beautiful straight and curved line patterns.

funActivities.title: Line Hunt 🔎
funActivities.description: Challenge your child to find 5 sleeping lines (like table edges) and 5 standing lines (like door frames) in a room.

funActivities.title: Body Lines 🤸‍♀️
funActivities.description: Ask your child to make standing, slanting, and sleeping lines using their whole body or arms.
